name: Almeda Mall
summary: Almeda Mall is a casual indoor shopping plaza in Houston featuring department stores, diverse dining options in its food court, and a wide selection of clothing, footwear, and jewelry shops. This distinctive shopping center offers something for everyone with top brands and family-friendly amenities.
demographics: Almeda Mall serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in southeast Houston, primarily attracting families and value-conscious shoppers from the surrounding neighborhoods. The trade area includes a mix of Hispanic, African American, and Asian communities with household incomes ranging from $35,000 to $65,000 annually. Typical visitors are budget-minded shoppers seeking affordable fashion, family dining options, and entertainment, with strong weekend traffic from multi-generational family groups. The center draws from a 5-10 mile radius including Pasadena, South Houston, and Pearland areas.
description: Almeda Mall stands as a distinctive shopping destination in Houston, Texas, offering a comprehensive retail experience for the entire family. This enclosed regional mall features a diverse selection of stores spanning fashion, footwear, jewelry, and more, complemented by department store anchors that provide one-stop shopping convenience. The mall's inviting food court presents a great selection of restaurants serving delicious cuisine, making it an ideal spot for families to refuel during their shopping adventures. Whether you're an outdoorsman seeking sporting goods or an urbanite looking for the latest fashion trends, Almeda Mall delivers with top brands and tempting options throughout its climate-controlled interior. Located at 555 Almeda Mall in Houston, this casual indoor shopping plaza has served the community for decades, evolving to meet the changing needs of southeast Houston residents while maintaining its commitment to accessible, family-friendly retail.
